description: Runtime knobs. Edit freely; the routine reads these on every run.

signal_window.description: UTC window during which signals may be generated. Outside this window the routine must post a WAIT message and exit.

macro_kill_switches.description: If VIX closes above vix_max, or today is an FOMC / CPI / NFP day, skip all signals and post the kill-switch Slack message.

confluence.description: 5-6 confirms = HIGH confidence. 4 confirms = MEDIUM confidence (note smaller size). ≤3 = WAIT.

risk.description: Stop = entry - (stop_atr_multiplier × ATR14). Target = entry + (target_atr_multiplier × ATR14). Trade only when risk:reward ≥ min_rr.
